messages:
Hannah: Published the postmortem for the 2026-03-20 serving incident. Link: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2345|RCA: Serving throughput degradation>. TL;DR — KV-cache evictions + fallback routing mismatch caused a brief spike in latency and a small climb in 5xxs. Impact window ~15m, ~3% of requests affected, sustained p95 increase for that window.

Hannah: Quick highlights and owner checklist below. Please confirm ETAs and add blockers.

Hannah: ACTIONS (owners):
- Fix fallback routing config to respect model-variant affinity (Kevin) — patch and roll by 2026-03-25.
- Add eviction-rate and per-shard KV cache metrics + alert (Maria) — instrument + alert by 2026-03-26.
- Run load replay against staging with cache warmup scenarios (Ryan / eng-sre) — schedule run and share results by 2026-03-29.
- Follow-up: weekly check-ins until all actions closed (Hannah) — calendar invite sent.

Kevin: Ack — taking the routing config fix. I'll open a branch + PR today and tag @Hannah for review. Note: this will need a short canary.

Maria: I'll add the eviction metrics. Planning to reuse the shard-level counter we discussed last quarter. Will post a short spec in #eng-infra by EOD.

Ryan: I'll own the replay. Need the traces / representative traffic file. @Hannah can you drop the replay list? Also propose we include a small latency chaos test.

Hannah: Uploaded the replay traces here: <https://internal.redwood.com/replays/serve-20260320|replay bundle>. Added notes on scenarios (cache cold/warm, fallback-enabled).

deploy-bot: RCA published to /postmortems and tracking ticket INC-34567 created; owners: Kevin, Maria, Ryan, Hannah.

Lisa: Can someone craft a 1-paragraph exec summary I can forward to ELT? Need by EOD so I can include in the weekly ops digest.

Hannah: Exec summary draft (3 lines): "On 2026-03-20 we observed a 15-minute throughput degradation caused by unexpected KV-cache evictions combined with a routing fallback path that bypassed cache affinity. ~3% of requests saw increased latency; no customer data was exposed. Action plan: routing patch, new eviction alerts, and replay verification. Owners have committed to fixes with completion targets by 2026-03-29."

Kevin: LGTM on exec summary.

Maria: +1 — will sync with observability team after instrumentation PR.

Ryan: Scheduling replay for 03/27 08:00 PT, will post results + perf graphs in this thread.

Hannah: Thanks all. Please update ticket INC-34567 with PR links and deployment notes. I'll run the weekly checkpoint on 03/28 and post status. :thumbsup:

Kevin: PR opened: <https://git.redwood.com/infra/patches/987|fix/fallback-routing>. tagging reviewers.

Maria: Instrumentation PR up next, will link here when ready.

Ryan: Replay scheduled and initial run completed — looks promising, p95 back to baseline when cache warm. Will attach full graphs after analysis.

Lisa: Thanks team — forwarding exec summary now.

Hannah: Closing note: if anyone hits blockers on their items, please flag immediately so we can escalate. Will keep this thread as the single source of truth for follow-ups.

Kevin: noted.

Maria: thanks.

Ryan: will report results in-channel.

Hannah: (reminder) Weekly checkpoint invite: 2026-03-28 10:00 PT.
